answer.rationale: The current situation requires minimizing total cost of ownership without increasing delivery risk. Adding a second source has been successful in the past (memory_c3) in removing a single point of failure and holding up allocation through a shortage. Given the assembly line is running at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, ensuring supply continuity is critical. The low-cost vendor has quoted a price that meets the finance mandate, making a switch or adding them as a second source viable. Verifying memory_c3 will provide more context on the effectiveness and potential risks of adding a second source.
